id.label: Creative ID
id.rule: NK + 3 digits, next free number in the Evergreen Video database. Never reuse.

concept.label: Concept
concept.rule: The brief title, max 30 characters, no / \ : ? * " < > | or _ inside.

hook.label: Hook
hook.rule: One file name per row of the HOOK table in the brief. H1 = first hook row.

body.label: Body
body.rule: Which cut of the body. A = first cut. The letter moves only when the body is re-edited; hooks keep their number.

avatar.label: Avatar
avatar.rule: Always exactly one. Never General or Multi. Map old labels: 'MIKE- BBQ KING' -> MIKE, 'JOHN - KNIFE COLLECTOR' -> JOHN, 'VANCE- The Opportunist' -> VANCE, 'STEVE - HOMECOOK' -> STEVE, 'SARAH - THE WIFE' -> SARAH, 'DON - THE HUNTER/BUSHCRAFT' -> DON, 'COLE - THE CAMPER/BUSHCRAFT' -> COLE, 'DANA - KNIFE SHARPENER' -> DANA, 'DARIEN - PROUD PARENTS' -> DARIEN.

offer.label: Offer shown
offer.rule: The offer said or shown in the video, not the offer live on site.

category.label: Category
category.rule: New = net-new idea. Ite = iteration of our own ad (say which kind in Iteration type). Adapt = adapted from another brand (say which in Source).

editor.label: Editor
editor.rule: The person who cuts the video. If unknown at brief time write EDITOR and let the editor replace it.

lp.label: Landing page
lp.rule: Map old labels: '6 Reasons - General' -> 6r-General, '6 Reasons - Santoku' -> 6r-Santoku, 'Listicle' -> 6r-General.

date.label: Date
date.rule: MM.DD.YY, the delivery date. Never an Excel serial number.

funnel.label: Funnel
funnel.rule: TOF finds new people and is judged on First Click ROAS. MOF warms people who saw us once. BOF closes people who already know us.

source.label: Source
source.rule: Only when Category is Adapt: the brand the mechanic was adapted from. Src-Other followed by the brand name with no spaces (Src-Other-Ollie). Src-None for New and for Ite (iterations do not carry the source ID; the Category and Iteration type say it is an iteration).

iteration.label: Iteration type
iteration.rule: Hook = new openings on a locked body. Body = same hook, new body. Product = same script, other knife. Persona = same script, other avatar. Editor = same brief cut by another editor. Voice = same cut, different voice (male to female, AI to creator). Music = same cut, different track. Offer = same cut, different offer line. Market = localised copy. CTA = only the ending changes. Length = shorter or longer cut. Reskin = same everything, new visuals. Ite-None when Category is New or Adapt.

creator.label: Creator
creator.rule: The person on camera or reading the lines. Not the editor. Cre-None for AI voice with no creator.

angle.label: Angle
angle.rule: What the ad argues, the reason to buy. One per ad. Value Offer = the deal itself. Cost Logic = the maths per use or versus what you already spend (Price Breakdown, Paying the Butcher, The Math Checks Out). Regret = a customer who paid full price warns you (Pissed Off, Not Paying Full Price, This Deal Annoyed Me). Industry Truth = the knife industry is lying to you, built to dull (Real Knife, Enemy Knife Industry, Nobody Tells You This). Relationship = the knife changes the couple or family dynamic (Save the marriage, Wife Will Make You Cook, you need a new wife). Versatility = one knife does every job and replaces the drawer (One Blade Does It All, Drawer Audit, Replace all your knives). Return = the owner cannot stop using it; the return request and the complaint is the proof (Return his knife Too big / Too good, Obsessed Husband, Kept Them All). Pain Point = the daily damage a dull knife does (What if, Wrist pain, Hunts ruined). Legacy = it outlives you and gets passed down (The Heirloom, The Will, Somebody Is Going To Inherit This); Durability is "for life", Legacy is "for the next one".

hookTactic.label: Hook tactic
hookTactic.rule: How the first line grabs. One per hook row. Joke = the opening is a gag. Shock = an outrageous line. Roast = insults the viewer or the old knife. Secret = 'let me tell you something nobody says'. Doubt = opens on the doubt itself ('you think this is a scam').

structure.label: Structure
structure.rule: How the script is built, the shape of the story. Not the argument. Str-Song = the script is sung or set to a music video.

proof.label: Proof element
proof.rule: Reviews = customer words or star rating. Count = a number (100,000 customers, sold out 15 times). Guarantee = warranty, returns. Press = media. Maker = the forge, the blacksmith, the making shown as proof of craft. Demo = the cut itself is the proof (cut test, paper slice).

offerTiming.label: Offer timing
offerTiming.rule: First = offer in the first 10 seconds. Mid = 40 to 70% through. Late = after 70%. House rule is Mid or Late.

productReveal.label: Product reveal
productReveal.rule: Early = the knife is named in the hook. Mid = named before the halfway point. Late = named after it.

face.label: Face on camera
face.rule: Talking = a person speaks to camera. Broll = a person appears in footage but nobody speaks to camera. Hands = hands only. AI = an AI person. None = product and footage only.

length.label: Length
length.rule: Len- followed by the real duration in seconds of the delivered file (Len-105). Write Len-TBD until the file exists.

id_rule: The name starts ID_VID_ : VID is written automatically after the ID, it is not a field anyone picks. It is how reporting tells video from image.
editable: Every field can be changed by hand, including the ID, the date, the hook count, the body letter and the length. The defaults are suggestions.
